inspiration: Lip-sync by phoneme table: a fixed set of 42 phoneme slots (lips.h line 10) with speech markers keyed to the audio position (SpeechMarker in lips.h). Recreate with a smaller mouth set of about 8 to 12 shapes that we draw ourselves, timed from our own voice track.

Automap view flags saved in the save file (automap.h lines 17-18). A map that remembers how the player last looked at it is a cheap way to make a town feel known. Recreate with our own isometric map projection.

Cutscenes as a streamed frame container with audio (movie_lib.cc, movie.cc, movie_effect.cc). The file names show movie playback as its own module with effects. Recreate with a standard video format and our own transitions, not the donor container.

Palette and colour system kept apart from art: color.cc and light.cc sit next to art.cc and tile.cc, so the look can be re-tinted by location or time of day. Recreate as one tint layer over our sprites.
Sound effects cached by list (sound_effects_cache.cc, sound_effects_list.cc) so repeated effects do not reload. Recreate as a simple preload list for our phone build.
Worldmap as its own module (worldmap.cc and worldmap.h). The name alone shows a separate travel view. Recreate as a route map on our own art. Source bodies not read.

briefs.label: Phoneme-timed talking head
briefs.why: A small set of mouth shapes timed to speech reads as talking without full animation, which is cheap on a phone.
